description: Cross-entropy after subtracting each target class's LDAM margin Δ_j=C/n_j^(1/4) from its logit; max_margin normalizes the largest margin (paper §3.2, Eqs. (11)-(13); Appendix B).

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    features = torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    label = int(int(ctx.index) % 4 == 0)
    features[0] += float(label)
    return {"features": synth.Tensor(features), "labels": label}
ds = synth.Spec("ldam-data", generator=samples, size=16, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("tabular-classify", split="train")
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=2)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, recipe="tabular-classify", recipe_config={"loss": "ldam", "loss_kwargs": {"counts": [12, 4], "max_margin": 0.5}}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train an imbalanced classifier with LDAM

name: Label-Distribution-Aware Margin (LDAM) Loss

parameters.additional parameters: **params accepts only counts and max_margin; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.counts: required finite positive training-example counts with shape [K], ordered by logit class (paper §3.2, Eqs. (11), (13))
parameters.ignore_index: optional integer target class excluded from reductions, or None (default None)
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point multiclass logits with shape [B, K]
parameters.max_margin: positive finite scalar largest target-class margin (default 0.5; derives C from counts)
parameters.reduction: none returns one value per sample; mean averages valid samples; sum totals valid losses (default mean)
parameters.targets: long tensor of class indices with shape [B], matching logits batch dimension
